- Every normative sentence of the 13 documents above traces to a rule sentence, overwrite replaced_by, factor ladder, variant parameter or tool contract. Explicitations checked and accepted as entailed: "latest by payment date" for the latest installment (compute `date_field='payment_date'`; rule "latest installment issued"); "A receipt carrying a payment reference means the payment was issued" (tool docstring).
- Added steps / confirmations / reviews / notifications: none found.
- Cross-problem operational guidance ("if unmet, first call ..."): none. Each task tool is named only in its own hub (move_ortho_case_49ae8ecf twice in transfer_entry_remaining_fee; issue_ortho_carried_payment_56eb10f4 twice in carried_benefit_payments).
- Task world state written as policy fact: none (no task names, case numbers, fees, dates or payment amounts of task 0 appear in any ortho document; all examples marked hypothetical and none equals a scored value: 1331.22, 237.92, 1050.00, 128.13 absent).
- Omissions: none found in the full domain (all tiers, including untriggered aligner / monthly / lump-sum / no-agreement / no-transfer branches, are carried).

## bijection_verdict

**PASS** (KB-BIJECTION). Retired surface correct for both overwrites of this task's policies (written as retired, unnamed clauses still in force, no undeclared retirement).

Policy-side observations (non-blocking, not KB defects):
- O1 (source wording): the progress_measure sentence says "the months after the banding month" without naming which entry's planned months; only the baseline sentence anchors "planned treatment months on the establishment entry". Compute uses the establishment entry (24). The KB carries the source wording; a reader taking the latest transfer entry (23) would get 1281.27. Closed in practice by the baseline anchor; recorded as openness of the source.

## dependency_form

- Prerequisite sentence: verbatim in the blocked policy's hub (carried_benefit_payments), state form; one same-form restatement in the same document. Not carried in any transfer document. No tool, policy id, route or chain beside it — the hub names only its own tool.
- Hold clause in the same hub ("paid only through the first carried payment once the case's transfer to that orthodontist is recorded") is the overwrite's replaced_by text of this very policy (source's own form), in the blocked policy's document; not RED.
- Titles: "Payments on a Case That Has Changed Orthodontist", "Transfer Entries When a Case Moves to a New Orthodontist", factor titles name general subjects; none mirrors the Halvorsen situation.
- Factor documents: none names the computation document or another factor; none says which tier most customers fall on.
- Computation documents: no "unless otherwise provided"/pointer/exception list. They do carry the source's generic assembly sentences ("Every ratio that applies to the unpaid case benefit is applied first", "Every amount taken off the carried benefit", "Every percentage held back", "times the service periods the first carried payment covers"; "every part taken off ... every part kept whole ... every percentage that applies"). These are the source rule's own `result` sentences (compute_basis.result), required by the render contract to sit with the assembly of the result; recorded as N1 (source-mandated, placement class), not as a KB defect.
- Findability: every factor reachable from record words (fixed_braces/new_start on the establishment entry, installment rows, transfer rows, network fields, D0150/D0330 paid lines of the Dental PPO enrollment, months_remaining on the transfer entry) — see blind item 6.

**PASS** (KB-EXPLICIT).

- N1 (non-blocking, source-mandated): generic assembly sentences in the computation documents name the kinds of adjustment; they come verbatim from the rule's own assembly sentence.

- Round-1 REDs: none to verify (revision_1 PASS on all three parts). Corpus and source unchanged (f95a665e3febf6b8; 7fb0c4d97ce747af / ae8fd16b76be984b); no regression, no new KB defect. source_to_kb / kb_to_source / dependency_form of revision_1 stand.
- Cross-product re-judge (task 0 world): see _difficulty.md revision_2. Member that moves this task's scored value: **S2** — Aksel's D0330 of 2026-10-06 (claim line 7e039e9a-a180-4c77-a235-8a449cc85278) is seeded PAID 118.00, but the Dental PPO Plans frequency schedule gives Plus 1500 a 60-month full-mouth/panoramic interval and the earlier panoramic of 2025-07-28 (6e0ed449..., paid 96.00) counts ("counted from the last paid one"); the line is over the interval and is denied with plan payment 0.00. Under records_paid_under_dental_plan the window would then hold a D0150 line only, "an evaluation line (D0150) only, or neither -> nothing", so the carried payment becomes 592.53 x 0.90 / 3 = 177.759 -> 177.76, x 2 periods = **355.52** (GT 237.92). The move's recognised fee (1331.22) does not read dental and is unaffected.
- bijection_verdict: **PASS** (unchanged). dependency_form: **PASS** (unchanged).
